about_the_game:
Gemmiferous is a Match 3 roguelike inspired by likes of “Slay the Spire” and “You Must Build a Boat” and classic game “Bejeweled”

Explore the vast dungeons under your manor and uncover old and hidden treasures. But beware or dark and long forgotten horrors which are also hiding in these dungeons.

Collect Gems, Coins and Materials and use them to repair the manor with its adjusted village. Purchase various upgrades in the village shops, visit the tavern and gamble all your hard worked gems, set up a production of materials and nearby forest, stone and iron mine. Decorate you village in a goal to make this place a new home for folk. Uncover all the mysteries of the manor and the village.

Features

  • 6 Playable Characters: As a lord you will hire rogues to enter the dungeons for you. All offering a slightly different playstyle to keep the game fresh

  • 60+ Monsters:  creating a wide variety of challenges

  • Random event room: game offers wide variety of random event rooms bringing some RNG luck to the game, inspired by Darkest Dungeon and Slay the Spire

  • Fast paced combat: In this game you must think fast and find matches fast in order to stay alive

  • Upgrade your weapons and items: Spend coins and gems and village shops to make next run more successful

  • Repair the Manor and Village: To gain access to many available facilities

  • Build houses and decor the Village: To increase your Village population

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4 Cores / 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Xe / Nvidia GTX 970 / AMD RX 570 (Adrenalin 22.1.2)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4 Cores / 3.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 / AMD RX 570 (Adrenalin 22.1.2)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: You inherited an old family manor in a land long forgotten and decayed. It is up to you to search the dungeons below the manor and find treasures and horrors long forgotten. Can you restore your legacy to its former glory in this pixel style dungeon crawler roguelike with an Match 3 combat style?
